documents.text:
[Page 1]
I, Priya Shah, a family service worker, make oath and say:
1. On February 3, 2026, I met with the mother at the Society's office.
2. On February 14, 2026, I spoke with the child's teacher, who told me the child had missed school.
[Page 2]
Sworn before me at the City of Toronto on February 10, 2026.
Commissioner for Taking Affidavits
